tools.name: check_china_twov_nationality_eligibility
tools.description: Verify whether a passport nationality qualifies for China 240-hour (upgraded from 72/144-hour) Visa-Free Transit (TWOV) and 24-hour direct airside transit.

tools.name: validate_third_country_itinerary_rule
tools.description: Validate whether a flight routing (Origin Country/Region A -> Mainland China B -> Destination Country/Region C, including Hong Kong, Macau, or Taiwan) satisfies strict NIA TWOV third-region rules vs round-trip disqualification.

tools.name: calculate_transit_stay_deadline
tools.description: Calculate the exact legal departure deadline under China Immigration midnight-next-day counting rules (00:00 the day following arrival) for 240-hour / 144-hour transit stays.

tools.name: lookup_china_transit_port_zone
tools.description: Look up permitted stay regions and approved entry/exit airports, seaports, and rail ports for Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Shanghai-Jiangsu-Zhejiang, Guangdong, Chengdu, Chongqing, Xi’an, and 24 provinces.

tools.name: check_24hour_direct_transit_rules
tools.description: Check rules for the 24-hour visa-free transit policy available to almost all nationalities, including multi-stop domestic transfers within 24 hours and airport-specific exemptions.

tools.name: get_airline_checkin_boarding_checklist
tools.description: Generate the mandatory printed document checklist required at airline check-in desks and China Immigration Temporary Entry Permit counters to prevent erroneous denied boarding.

tools.name: lookup_china_visa_photo_specs
tools.description: Retrieve official Chinese Embassy COVA digital visa photo and physical print dimensions (33mm x 48mm, head height 28-33mm, pure white RGB 255,255,255 background).

tools.name: compare_twov_vs_unilateral_30day_visa_free
tools.description: Compare whether a traveler can use China’s 30-day unilateral visa-free entry (allows round-trip flights) vs 240-hour TWOV (requires third-country onward ticket).
